name: fitness-tracker
description: Log workouts, weigh-ins, meals, and progress photos in natural language, and analyze progress against a stored goal and plan.

interface.shortDescription: Natural-language training, nutrition, and progress log.
interface.longDescription: Connects to your personal Fitness Tracker MCP server. Log resistance training, weigh-ins, meals, and progress photos from plain language, and review trends against your stored goal and active plan. Each person signs in with Google and reaches only their own data.
defaultPrompt: Log today's workout: bench 3x8 at 185, then incline DB 3x10 at 70s.
How's my bench trend this month against my goal?
